hook_line: FRESHWORKS ALUMNI RAISE $53 MILLION TO BUILD AI-NATIVE CRM DREAMTEAM

hook_stat.sub: Raised across a seed led by Together Fund and a Series A led by Accel

stats.label: Customers signed in three months, across 13 countries
Built-in AI agents in the CRM
People employed, engineering team in Chennai

diaspora_bullets: The three founders helped scale Freshworks from its early startup days through its IPO
The California-based company runs its engineering team in Chennai
news_summary: Three former Freshworks executives have raised $53 million for Dreamteam, an AI-native CRM whose Company Brain builds a living record from emails and meetings.
payoff: Dreamteam aims to reach eight figures in annual revenue by the end of 2027.
